decision_notes: Official explanation establishes decrees with force of law, budget decrees and government scrutiny including confidence/no-confidence. Regional legislature of federal Belgium. Primary evidence: https://www.parlement-wallonie.be/les-fonctions-du-depute-wallon

Institution-linked channel: 14 October 2026 plenary and committee recordings play beyond opening graphics. Official terms expressly allow links and reproduction of parliamentary debates/recordings with source acknowledgement and context integrity; framing website pages needs permission.

Source conditions: The legal notice distinguishes ordinary site content from debates: parliamentary debates and their audiovisual recordings may be reproduced, with source attribution and no distortion of the meaning when excerpted. Ordinary material remains private/noncommercial unless otherwise permitted, and framing site pages needs formal permission. This addition retains official link-out and does not claim a stable independently reusable stream.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
